name: wiki
description: Indexed knowledge bases with command-line tools for agents.

interface.shortDescription: Indexed knowledge bases with command-line tools for agents.
interface.longDescription: A wiki keeps project knowledge as plain markdown, indexed at every level by _index.md files, read by consulting the index and opening only the pages a task needs. The wiki CLI regenerates index link blocks and page frontmatter from the filesystem, lints structure and links, searches pages by full text, and installs a git merge driver that auto-resolves the generated region of index files, so parallel agent edits conflict only on authored prose.
